end.summary:
Arjun showed how to order three or more distances in mixed units, including a why/new-situation question.
They practised finding how much farther one distance is than another; a why or new-situation check is still needed next time.
There was a mix-up with 1 km 40 m, and they later converted it to 1040 m and placed it after 750 m and 980 m.
They also practised converting kilometres and metres into metres for comparison.
end.parentNote: Arjun practised comparing distances by converting kilometres to metres and then ordering the values. They showed the ordering method in several examples; finding how much farther one distance is than another was practised with an easy question and needs a why or new-situation check next time. There was a brief mix-up with 1 km 40 m, which they corrected by making it 1040 m. At home, ask them to compare two distances and explain which unit conversion they used.
